themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints spiked to 46 this week versus a 9.5-per-week average over the prior 8 weeks—a 384% surge (z-score: 5.35)—suggesting a major sanitation service breakdown affecting waste removal across Greenpoint/Williamsburg THIS WEEK.
evidence: 46 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 9.5 weekly average (384% spike)
Z-score of 5.35 indicates highly statistically significant deviation
Sustained pattern emerging last week (prior week also elevated at ~46), suggesting ongoing operational issue
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents about overflowing bins and missed pickups; contact Sanitation Department about route coverage and staffing
Investigate whether collection contractor staffing shortages, vehicle breakdowns, or route changes triggered this week's spike

themes_detail.label: Park Safety and Conduct Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Over the past 2 weeks, park-related 311 complaints have surged: noise in parks up 586% (6 complaints last week vs. 0.9 average), park rule violations up 700% (4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 average), and outdoor dining complaints up 700% (4 complaints last week vs. 0.5 average)—signaling possible overcrowding, after-hours activity, or enforcement gaps at a time when Bushwick Inlet Park remains under development.
evidence: Noise - Park: 6 complaints last week vs. 0.9 weekly average (586% increase, z-score: 4.87)
Violation of Park Rules: 4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 4.95)
Outdoor Dining: 4 complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 4.95)
Bushwick Inlet Park construction ongoing (per Brooklyn Eagle, April 8)—limited park access may concentrate users in existing parks
reporting_angles: Speak with Parks Enforcement and Parks Dept. about staffing levels and what rule violations are being reported (drinking, late-night gatherings, unpermitted vendors)
Interview residents near popular parks (East River Waterfront, McCarren Park) about noise and overcrowding; tie to longer-term lack of park infrastructure in district (repeated CB budget request)

themes_detail.label: Electrical System Failures or Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints jumped 833% to 7 three weeks ago versus a 0.8 per-week average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.74)—a dramatic spike that may indicate widespread electrical infrastructure problems, hazardous conditions, or a concentrated incident affecting multiple properties.
evidence: 7 electrical complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (833% spike, z-score: 5.74)
Spike occurred 3 weeks ago—slightly older than this week's emerging issues but still highly anomalous
No follow-up spike data suggests issue may have been resolved or was localized incident
reporting_angles: Contact DOE/ConEd about outages, downed lines, or service disruptions 3 weeks ago in specific neighborhoods
Investigate whether electrical spike correlates with any construction activity or weather events

themes_detail.label: Police Enforcement Surge
themes_detail.summary: Real Time Enforcement complaints spiked 336% to 18 three weeks ago (vs. 4.1 weekly average, z-score: 4.95), and Investigations and Discipline (IAD) complaints surged 1500% to 4 complaints three weeks ago (vs. 0.2 average, z-score: 5.67)—suggesting either a major policing action or resident concerns about enforcement practices emerged last month.
evidence: Real Time Enforcement: 18 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 4.1 weekly average (336% increase, z-score: 4.95)
IAD complaints: 4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score: 5.67)
Both spikes occurred simultaneously 3 weeks ago, suggesting coordinated enforcement action or response
reporting_angles: NYPD precinct (Williamsburg, Greenpoint) for details on enforcement operations, foot traffic initiatives, or complaint surge from 3 weeks ago
Interview residents and community advocates about police visibility and whether enforcement was felt as targeted or aggressive
